leads.title: Kerrigan v. Commissioner of Public Health
leads.documents: Connecticut Supreme Court ruling that same-sex couples have a constitutional right to marry and that civil union statute violated equal protection clause of state Constitution
leads.detail: Connecticut Supreme Court, decided October 10, 2008; case brought in 2004 by eight same-sex couples denied licenses in Madison; first marriages November 12

leads.title: H.B. No. 7006 - Birth Certificate Gender Marker Law
leads.documents: Makes it easier for transgender people to change gender marker on birth certificate without surgery; establishes affidavit process and M/F/X options for birth certificates, IDs and driver's licenses
leads.detail: Passed June 2015, Senate 32-3 and House 126-18; signed by Governor Dannel Malloy; effective October 1, 2015; Department of Public Health affidavit from applicant plus physician/APRN/psychologist

leads.title: HB 6695 - Conversion Therapy Ban
leads.documents: Bans conversion therapy on minors in Connecticut
leads.detail: Passed House May 2, 2017 by 141-8; passed Senate May 10 by 36-0 (18-Republican and 18-Democrat); signed by Governor Dannel Malloy, effective immediately

leads.title: Connecticut Gay Panic Defense Repeal Bill
leads.documents: Repeals gay panic defense in Connecticut
leads.detail: Passed Connecticut General Assembly unanimously June 2019; signed by Governor Ned Lamont; effective October 1, 2019

leads.title: Governor Lamont Signs Legislation Strengthening the Ability to Prosecute Hate Crimes - Press Release
leads.documents: Consolidated and strengthened hate crime legislation explicitly including sexual orientation and gender identity and expression, with additional penalties

leads.title: Fowler v. State
leads.documents: Connecticut Supreme Court ruling that law against 'lascivious carriage and behavior' applied only to opposite-sex conduct; later basis for dismissal of same-sex charge against Max Fenster in 1962
leads.detail: Connecticut Supreme Court, 1811; cited in 1962 Fenster case where court unanimously agreed law covered only opposite-sex conduct

leads.title: Connecticut Anti-Discrimination Law - Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity Protections
leads.documents: Bans discrimination on basis of sexual orientation and gender identity or expression in employment, housing, public accommodations, governmental services; plus anti-bullying law covering schools including cyberbullying
leads.detail: Sexual orientation prohibited since 1991, gender identity or expression added 2011; June 2023 bill to reform/update 1991 definition of sexual orientation passed Legislature

leads.title: Connecticut Parentage Reforms Bill
leads.documents: Legally recognises same-sex parentage for children of same-sex couples without regard to marital status; aligns IVF/birth certificate law
leads.detail: Passed Connecticut General Assembly May 2021; signed by Governor Ned Lamont; effective October 1, 2021

leads.title: Connecticut Prison Reform - Transgender Housing Policy
leads.documents: First jurisdiction in US to ensure all individuals treated consistent with gender identity regarding strip searches, clothing, commissary, educational materials, and housing based on recognized gender

leads.title: Federal Dismissal of Connecticut Transgender Sports Lawsuits
leads.documents: Dismissal of 2020 high-profile lawsuits regarding transgender individuals playing sports/athletics within Connecticut
leads.detail: Federal judge dismissal April 2021; article states it triggered 50+ bills across state legislatures and US Congress about banning transgender athletes
